definitions.description: Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation is August 16. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools.
Each high school may replace the listed April 10 and May 8 staff workdays with another date in the same month.
Staff workdays extend the Labor Day and Presidents Day weekends and keep students out through January 3 after winter break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school in Adams 12?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin for all Adams 12 students on Tuesday, August 17, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Do sixth- and ninth-grade students start earlier?
calendarFaqs.a: Sixth- and ninth-grade students attend orientation on Monday, August 16. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Adams 12 students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter break ends Friday, December 31, 2027. Monday, January 3 is a staff workday, so students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Can Adams 12 high schools choose different staff workdays?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Each high school may replace the listed April 10 and May 8 staff workdays with another date in the same month.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the Adams 12 district calendar page, the official 2027–28 PDF, and your school’s calendar. The district PDF is marked subject to revision.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: School starts on August 17, compared with August 11 in 2026–27.
The last student day is May 25, compared with May 20 in 2026–27.
Fall, Thanksgiving, and winter breaks begin one day earlier in their respective months than in 2026–27; spring break begins two days earlier.
